theme.note: CC-0008: the template's neutral palette (shared/channel_template/config.json), nobody's brand - every value is in `picked`. Replace it with the channel's brand palette (docs/channel-data.md «The theme»); the factory's contrast rules check it on every save.

status_note: CC-0008: created from the command center on {{created}} from the factory's template (shared/channel_template, shared/new_channel.py). A channel without a pipeline yet: no run_plan (the executor refuses it), no publisher (no slot, no queue), batch_schedule.enabled false (the factory's daily batch never goes here). Every reader of channels/*.json says «конвейера нет - батча не будет» for it (shared/channel_ids.py: no_pipeline_reason). The blocks a pipeline reads - scope, sources, patterns, insert layers, voice, the lists in channels/{{channel_id}}/ (fact-sources, rights-holder-blacklist, footage-origin) - are added by editing this file; the status key goes away together with this note when the channel gets its run_plan.

batch_schedule.note: CC-0008: a new channel is created off the schedule - no pipeline, no run_plan, the daily batch never comes here. It is turned on when the channel has its run_plan.

stance_note: CC-0008: the channel's position - the template's empty skeleton until a person writes it (channels/{{channel_id}}/stance.json).
